facts.label: Official residence authority
facts.text: Temporary and permanent residence routes for foreigners are administered by Immigration Department, Government of Montserrat. Read the current official route names, minimum presence and fees on that site.

facts.label: Scope
facts.text: This pattern covers official temporary and permanent residency, including published minimum presence and costs where known. It does not cover short visitor visas, which sit under Entry and Visa preparation.

citizenship.summary: Official naturalisation, descent and dual-citizenship rules in Montserrat, for an Australian passport holder.

facts.label: Dual citizenship (destination rule)
facts.text: Whether the destination allows dual citizenship should be confirmed on the official nationality pages. Do not assume that a residence permit leads to citizenship, or that Australia's rule applies there.

facts.label: Citizenship by descent
facts.text: Many countries have a descent route with official documentary conditions. Confirm eligibility on the official nationality pages before planning around it.

facts.label: Official authority
facts.text: Start with Immigration Department, Government of Montserrat for official naturalisation, descent and dual-citizenship rules.

citizenship.notes: Australian law also matters: Australia allows its citizens to hold another citizenship. That does not change the destination country's own dual-citizenship rules.
